title: Closeout summary: Portfolio container views - cross-boundary dep tree and blocked reasons
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Implemented external-aware dep tree rendering for cross-project blockers, including project name, referenced work status, stale state, and typed resolution states. Added runtime coverage for resolved-open, resolved-terminal, unresolved-unlinked, and stale dep-tree nodes. Validation: focused global readiness vitest passed; apps/cli TypeScript build passed; pnpm check passed.

Close reason: portfolio cross-boundary dep tree views implemented and verified
